CROSSTRADE APIACCOUNTSGET ACCOUNT
On this page
GET Account
NT8
Tradovate
Get a specific account by name NT8​

Returns current details and balance information for one named NinjaTrader account.

Endpoint​

GET /v1/api/accounts/{account}

Headers​
NAME	VALUE
Content-Type	application/json
Authorization	Bearer <token>
Path parameters​
NAME	TYPE	REQUIRED	DESCRIPTION
account	string	Required	Name of account in NT8
Code examples​
Python
JavaScript
cURL
import requests



token = 'my-secret-token'



url = "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/accounts/Sim101"

headers = {

    "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",

    "Content-Type": "application/json"

}



try:

    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

    print(f"Response Code: {response.status_code}, Response Text: {response.text}")

except Exception as e:

    print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

Success field types​

Float fields accept whole or fractional JSON numbers. Account-item values can be null when NT8 cannot read them.

FIELD	TYPE	DESCRIPTION
success	boolean	true on success.
id	integer	NT8 account ID.
name, displayName, type, provider, denomination, status	string	Account identity, provider, currency and status.
primaryUser	null in captures	No populated primary-user value captured.
commissionTemplate, connection, connectionName	string or null	Commission template and connection metadata.
connectionStatus	string	Broker connection status.
isAccountFlat	boolean	Whether the account is flat.
dailyLossLimit, minCashValue	float	Account limits.
maxOrderSize, maxPositionSize	integer	Quantity limits.
item	object	Account values below, each float or null.
item.buyingPower, item.cashValue, item.commission, item.fee	float or null	Available funds and costs.
item.dailyLossLimit, item.dailyProfitTrigger, item.trailingMaxDrawdown	float or null	Daily risk limits.
item.excessInitialMargin, item.excessIntradayMargin, item.excessMaintenanceMargin, item.excessPositionMargin	float or null	Excess margin values.
item.initialMargin, item.intradayMargin, item.lookAheadMaintenanceMargin, item.maintenanceMargin, item.positionMargin	float or null	Margin requirements.
item.grossRealizedProfitLoss, item.realizedProfitLoss, item.unrealizedProfitLoss	float or null	P/L in currency units.
item.longOptionValue, item.longStockValue, item.shortOptionValue, item.shortStockValue	float or null	Holdings valuations.
item.netLiquidation, item.netLiquidationByCurrency, item.totalCashBalance	float or null	Account valuations.
item.sodCashValue, item.sodLiquidatingValue	float or null	Start-of-day valuations.
item.weeklyLossLimit, item.weeklyProfitLoss, item.weeklyProfitTrigger	float or null	Weekly P/L and limits.
Platform nuances​

NT8 account fields are returned at the top level. Current balance and margin values are nested under item.

WebSocket API​

This request can also be made over the WebSocket API. The account path parameter is passed inside args.

{

  "action": "rpc",

  "id": "my-request-id",

  "api": "GetAccount",

  "args": {

    "account": "Sim101"

  }

}
